note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after ca4eae70a0). Section 7.2: "An AS_PATH is considered malformed if an unrecognized segment type is encountered or if it contains a malformed segment." and "An UPDATE message with a malformed AS_PATH attribute SHALL be handled using the approach of "treat-as-withdraw"." RFC 9774 Section 3 (owner decision: AS_SET is treat-as-withdraw) now makes validateASPath return asPathSetVerdict after the structure walk. TestRFC7606ASPathValidSet changed from asserting None to asserting TreatAsWithdraw with the exact description "RFC 9774 Section 3: AS_SET in AS_PATH". As a 7.2 positive it still discriminates: a regression that read AS_SET (type 1) as an unrecognized or malformed segment returns from the walk first with a Section 7.2 description and fails the exact Equal; the input is well-framed so nothing else trips. It no longer proves acceptance, which is correct now that RFC 9774 deprecates AS_SET; TestRFC7606ASPathValidSequence remains the exact-None positive. The four isolated negatives (segment type, overrun, underrun, zero length) are unchanged.
